title: Standard BioTools Inc. 8-K Filing — Notice of Delisting or Failure to Satisfy Continued Listing Rule
summary: Standard BioTools Inc. (ticker LAB) received a Nasdaq notification on April 20, 2026 that its share price fell below the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for 30 consecutive business days, triggering a 180-day compliance period expiring October 19, 2026.
key_points: Standard BioTools Inc. (LAB) received Nasdaq delisting notice on April 20, 2026 due to closing bid price below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days
Company has until October 19, 2026 to maintain bid price above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days to regain compliance
Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(1) establishes the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for The Nasdaq Global Select Market
Company may qualify for additional 180-day compliance period by transferring listing to The Nasdaq Capital Market
Trading of LAB common stock continues uninterrupted on Nasdaq Global Select Market during compliance period
No immediate effect on company's SEC reporting obligations or business operations
